$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-defaultunits-100microns.xml (Rule 10, D-030). DefaultUnits="100Microns", the compound unit token, with a StepSize whose X and Y differ in the second decimal - 6.3 against 6.4. DefaultUnits is xs:string with no enumeration, so the token is carried verbatim and never resolved to a scale factor by this engine; a consumer that normalised it to microns would silently change every physical dimension in the document by two orders of magnitude.
